answer: Ask what breaks first: the juror who never reads. Pay jurors only when their score matches the median, and slash the bond of any juror 2 points off. Burn the recruiter's standing when a recruit duplicates. Compare submissions by replay, so a renamed copy still collides. The cost is the panel: 5 bonded jurors per answer, each risking an anchor of stake. Collusion must buy 3 of 5, and one ivory record of a bad score taints the saffron of its payout.
